newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee weakens, RBI buys forward dollars.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee weakens, RBI buys forward dollars.

text.p: The rupee weakened to 35.73/74 per dollar on corporate demand and Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervention in the forward dollar market, dealers said.
"The RBI bought October dollars," a dealer said.
"There have been deals upto 35.73," he said.
The rupee opened the day steady at 35.705/710.
"They (RBI) have intervened in forwards after a long spell," said a dealer.
RBI has bought dollars from the spot market in recent months.
In latest deals, the dollar was quoted 35.732/742 rupees.
